Metadata.title: Hoopo: English with a roadmap made for you
Metadata.description: Live English classes with a real teacher, private or in a group, with a personal roadmap for your goal and an AI assistant. Book your free session.

groupRoadmap.q: Is my roadmap personal in a group class too?
groupRoadmap.a: Yes. Groups are matched by level, but your stops, homework and between-class practice follow your own goal.

privateOrGroup.q: Private or group: which is better?
privateOrGroup.a: Private if your goal is urgent or your schedule changes a lot. Group if you enjoy practising with real people. We decide together in the free session.

aiWhen.q: When will the AI assistant be ready?
aiWhen.a: We're building it now. Leave your email to be the first to try it. Until then, {teacher} and your roadmap have you covered.

aiReplace.a: Never. {teacher} is your teacher and draws your route. The assistant just helps you stay on it between classes.

need.q: What do I need for class?
need.a: A phone or laptop, headphones and an internet connection. Nothing to install. Weak connection? You can join with audio only.

guides.teacherBody: Listens to your level and goal, draws your personal roadmap, and is with you in a live class every week.
guides.t1: A roadmap built on your own goal

guides.h2: A personal summary after every session
guides.h3: Doesn't replace {teacher}; helps you reach the next class

hero.lead: Classes, students, homework and payments in one place. Between lessons, Hoopo practices with your students so they show up ready.

card.ready: 3 of 4 students are ready for today’s class.

loop.lead: Hoopo learns from your lesson plan and practices with each student between sessions. Before the next class, you know exactly where to start.

s1.title: You set the lesson topic
s1.detail: For example, “Talking about work experience.” From this, Hoopo knows what each student should practice before the next class.
s1.sample: Monday session · B1 group · Topic: talking about work experience

s2.title: Hoopo gets students ready
s2.detail: The day before class, a five-minute warm-up with the words and questions for that topic, so students speak from minute one.
s2.sample: “Sara, want to go over six work words for tomorrow?”

s3.title: In class, you just teach
s3.detail: Hoopo listens and saves the corrections you make for each student, ready to review later.
s3.sample: I have went → I went · saved for Sara’s review

s4.title: A report before the next class
s4.detail: Who practiced, where they’re stuck, and what Hoopo suggests to open the next lesson. Then the loop starts again with you.
s4.sample: 12 of 16 exercises done · Suggestion: ten minutes on the present perfect

time.lead: Hoopo takes care of scheduling, homework reminders and payment messages. Your part is the teaching.

i1.title: No more missed lessons
i1.body: Students get a reminder an hour before every class.

i2.title: One class link, for good
i2.body: Online classes run inside Hoopo, so you never send a new link again.

i3.title: Homework that follows itself up
i3.body: See who has handed in, and Hoopo nudges the rest.

chart.title: A teacher’s week with 20 students
chart.savedBody: hours a week back for teaching, rest, or more students.

money.quote: “Payment reminders are on me. Polite and on time.”
money.lead: Hoopo sends each term’s invoice, follows up politely and on time, and records every payment. You just read the report.

i1.title: Reminders without the awkwardness
i1.body: The reminder comes from Hoopo, not from your phone.

i2.title: A receipt for every payment
i2.body: No more scattered transfers and screenshots.

i3.title: Your monthly income, always clear
i3.body: See what’s paid and what’s outstanding at any moment.

d4.title: Monthly report
d4.body: Income and balances at a glance

progress.quote: “Every step forward, my crest opens up.”
progress.lead: Every student gets their own learning path: where they are, how far they’ve come and what’s next. You see everyone’s progress at a glance and spot who needs help sooner.

page.lead: Students meet you by name, see your classes and rates, and book a placement session straight from your calendar. Hoopo is just a small signature at the bottom.
page.name: Mona

learners.title: Your learning path, free.
learners.lead: Placement and a personal learning path are free for everyone. With Hoopo Plus (coming soon), practice conversation whenever you like, with or without a teacher.

data.a: You do. Export your student list and records anytime. Hoopo never refers your students to another teacher.

ai.a: No. Hoopo practices with students based on the plan and topics you set, then reports back to you. The teacher always makes the call.

install.q: Do students need to install an app?
install.a: No. Hoopo runs in the browser on phones and laptops. Students just open the class link.
